name: Fountain Finances Editorial Team
bio: The Fountain Finances editorial team researches and writes every guide on this site. We build each article from primary sources — the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, the Federal Reserve, the FDIC, the IRS, the U.S. Department of Education and official lender and bank disclosures — and we re-check the facts on a published review schedule. Our goal is simple: explain money decisions clearly enough that you can make them yourself.
